summary: Iteration 40: P1 Features Testing - ALL TESTS PASSED. Backend: 25/25 tests passed. Frontend: All role-based route guards verified. CRITICAL BUG FIXED: JWT token_version not included in access tokens causing 'Token revoked' errors after logout.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED BUG: create_token() was not including token_version in JWT payload, causing all tokens to fail validation after any user logged out (token_version incremented)
Updated create_token() in services/auth.py to accept token_version parameter
Updated all create_token() calls in routes/auth.py to pass token_version from user record
Updated impersonation token creation in routes/admin.py to include token_version
Repository pattern correctly implemented in dashboard.py, broadcasts.py, engagement.py
TenantScopedRepository enforces tenant_id on all queries - prevents cross-tenant data access
Payment idempotency via acquire_idempotency_lock() in razorpay_webhook.py working correctly
JWT refresh token architecture: access tokens (2hr) + refresh tokens (30 days) + token_version for forced logout
Frontend SuperAdminRoute guard correctly blocks tenant_admin from /dashboard/saas-management and /dashboard/risk-alerts
Frontend TenantRoute guard allows tenant_admin access to tenant-specific pages
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 40 verified P1 features and FIXED a critical bug: 1) JWT Refresh Token Architecture - login returns both token and refresh_token, POST /api/auth/refresh works correctly, logout increments token_version, 2) CRITICAL FIX: create_token() now includes token_version in JWT payload - previously all tokens failed after any logout, 3) Repository Pattern Migration - dashboard.py, broadcasts.py, engagement.py all use TenantScopedRepository, 4) Payment Idempotency - acquire_idempotency_lock() in razorpay_webhook.py prevents double-processing, 5) Frontend route guards working - SuperAdminRoute blocks tenant_admin from saas-management and risk-alerts, TenantRoute allows tenant-specific pages. All 25 backend tests passed, all frontend tests passed.
